messages:
Alex: Console PM asked for a "policy preview" UX to simulate routing effects before rollouts. They want SDKs to optionally emit a tiny telemetry header we can correlate.
Riley: Important: header must be telemetry-only. No routing changes unless server-side canary is explicitly enabled.
Jordan: Suggest SDK opt-in flag + env sampler. Example JS: `new Redwood({apiKey:process.env.KEY, policyPreview:true})` and env `REDWOOD_POLICY_PREVIEW_RATE=0.01`.
Priya: Py/Go mirror API: optional ctor arg or opts pattern. Headers emitted: `x-rwd-policy-preview:1` and `x-rwd-policy-preview-id:<hex>`.
Ken: Add telemetry event `policy_preview.toggled` with sdk/version so we can measure. Throttle header emission for high-throughput clients (token-bucket).
Alex: Backcompat: default off. Opt-in minor semver. Docs must state sample ids are ephemeral/non-PII.
Design-Bot: Noted for Console mock: will produce a sampled preview card with clear badge and tenant vs user toggle, mock by Fri.
CI-Bot: canary build queued: preview-sdk-canary-17499922 :rocket:
